name: Call of Fire

angles.text: As a shaman, you undergo this rite of initiation and earn a Fire Totem when you complete it. The totem grants you mastery over fire.
As a Skyborne, you follow a shamanic tradition in which the Windshapers of Skywall guide initiates in honoring the elemental planes.

faq.answer: Call of Fire sends an aspiring shaman to summon spirits of flame and catch the Eternal Flame. Carrying it to Valanaar proves the initiate’s respect for the elemental plane and earns a Fire Totem.
faq.q: What is the Call of Fire?

faq.answer: Olariaan leads the ceremony at the Brazier of Offering. He places materials on the altar and calls the spirits of flame to kindle the Eternal Flame.

The Eternal Flame comes from spirits of flame called forth from the Firelands during the Windshaper ritual. Initiates catch it on a torch and use it to kindle the Brazier of Eternal Flames in Valanaar.
The flame comes from the Firelands, and its heat fades quickly in Skywall’s air. Initiates hurry so the torch stays lit until they reach Valanaar.
faq.q: Why must the flame be carried quickly to Valanaar?

faq.answer: The Windshapers are an order in Skywall who guide initiates through elemental trials. They honor the balance and power of the elemental planes and oversee the granting of totems.

aliases: what do you get from call of fire
faq.answer: An initiate who completes the ritual and rekindles the brazier in Valanaar earns a Fire Totem, a focus for channeling fiery elemental power.
faq.q: What is the reward for completing the trial?

sections.body: Olariaan of the Windshapers guides initiates through a sacred trial at Skywall. They gather at the Brazier of Offering and call to spirits of flame from the Firelands. If their offerings are worthy, the spirits kindle the altar with the Eternal Flame. A worthy initiate may then take up that flame.
sections.title: The Ritual of Flame

sections.body: The Eternal Flame must be caught on a torch and carried across Skywall to Valanaar. In this elemental realm, its power from the Firelands fades in the swirling air. The initiate must reach the Brazier of Eternal Flames before the torch goes dark.
sections.title: The Journey to Valanaar

sections.body: When an initiate rekindles the brazier at Valanaar, the Windshapers grant them a Fire Totem. It honors their discipline and respect for the elements. The elders teach that elemental power serves those who respect it, but consumes those who do not.
sections.title: The Fire Totem

summary: At Skywall, initiates face the Windshapers’ trial and seek a Fire Totem. They summon spirits of flame, bear the Eternal Flame to Valanaar, and kindle its brazier.
attribution: In-game quest text: Call of Fire
